original: WPRPLACE is a waterfall located in the Highland in Iceland. It is almost on the road leading to Lakagígar craters on road F206.24 km from Kirkjubæjarklaustur and 40 km from Laki. Access to the waterfall requires the crossing of a river ford, for which a 4x4 vehicle is needed.

Der Zugang zum Wasserfall erfordert die Überquerung einer Flussfurt, für die ein 4x4-Fahrzeug benötigt wird.
